body.p: The directories list the proprietors as Mary Mather (1874 to 1890, also spelt "Meather" in 1874 and 1875), Miss Annie Angus (1895, Mrs Ann Angus in 1900), Mrs K. Fitzgerald (1905), Mrs Hammon (1910) and Mrs Bertha M. Crowley (1915).
